reuse.why: The change reuses getScheduledAmount and getApproxNumberThreshold across consumers, but leaves forecast normalization outside the shared amount abstraction.

duplication.why: Several local amount calculations are consolidated, but normalizeSchedule retains a separate numeric/range calculation.

placement.why: Schedule amount policy belongs in shared/schedules.ts, with tolerance calculation delegated to shared/rules.ts and API enrichment kept at the API boundary.

scope.why: The edits are focused on schedule amount policy, its consumers, and the requested API field with supporting types, documentation, and tests.

maintainability.why: Centralization improves ownership, but the separate forecast calculation leaves maintainers with competing definitions of expected schedule amounts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts: normalizeSchedule retains local amount resolution instead of using getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff replaces local calculations with shared calls without introducing renamed or reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount adds amountOp and an approximate-amount branch; normalizeSchedule in server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts remains a bypassing consumer with its own amount policy.
